entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: Duxbury et al. (2004) report minimum full dimensions of 6.6 × 5.0 × 3.4 km from limited Stardust flyby viewing. The selected ellipsoid uses those extents as a coarse approximation, without reproducing the angular outline, unseen surface, spin pole or current longitude. The preparation halves the full axes once; its geometric-mean reference radius is a rendering scale. No formal axis error is carried in the retained measurements.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: Stardust NAVCAM observations exist, but this review found no reusable global raster registered to the selected display ellipsoid. The existing grid is authored missing-data display, not evidence of mapped coverage; disk-integrated spectra are not surface maps.
entries.revisitWhen: A released reusable observation or mapped product supplies its pixel geometry and registration to a source model that can be compared with the selected ellipsoid.

entries.subject: NASA Stardust mission page
entries.finding: The NASA mission page provides mission context only. It is not a body shape, image, geometry, or map product and supplies no scientific input to this package.
entries.revisitWhen: The mission page publishes or links a versioned Annefrank product with enough native metadata to assess it as a source candidate.

entries.subject: Stardust NAVCAM raw images of Annefrank v3.0
entries.finding: The PDS catalogue identifies SDU-A-NAVCAM-2-EDR-ANNEFRANK-V3.0 as raw pre-encounter and encounter images. The catalogue page establishes product existence, but this ledger review did not retrieve labels, image bytes, reconstructed pointing, or a model-registration product. Raw availability therefore does not qualify a texture or a scientific surface view.
entries.revisitWhen: The native product labels and applicable SPICE/reconstructed geometry are inspected and can be matched to a released shape or supported registration route.

entries.subject: Stryk and Stooke (2016) partial Annefrank map
entries.finding: The LPSC abstract reports mirrored-image correction, scattered-light removal and frame stacking, and its Figure 4 shows a simple cylindrical partial map. The displayed figure uses tentative ellipsoid control; it does not publish labelled longitude bounds, native raster bytes, or clear reuse terms. It is a promising map route, but does not establish registration to this package’s ellipsoid.
entries.revisitWhen: The authors or an archive release the map raster and control/shape definition with terms that permit reuse and comparison with the selected model.
